recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-32981 unless a future generated publication check unexpectedly omits Device from Basic.author.
issue_request: FHIR-32981 was a Published FHIR-core Basic change request resolved Persuasive for R5. It requested allowing Device-authored Basic resources by adding Device to the Basic.author Reference target list.
initial_application: Basic is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/basic/structuredefinition-Basic.xml already includes Device as a Basic.author targetProfile. No source commit subject names FHIR-32981 directly, but 900cdc56b505d3070cb5f1b3eb47fd8730d246b3 added Device to Basic.author and was merged through the later FHIR-35913 Basic branch; the Jira comment cites c329dc9fb41505fba511a39f0202f45855abdf52, a later merge whose first parent already contained the Basic.author change.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2021-12-20 record FHIR-32981 as Persuasive with a 5-0-0 vote. FHIR-35913 later referenced FHIR-32981 and added CareTeam alongside the already-approved Device target. Searches found no later final core Jira or Zulip discussion reversing the Device target.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current authoritative source already implements the requested Device target on active Basic.author.
